verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. Managing Git submodules is a source-control capability outside its product category, so the story is the wrong axis for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale itself offering Git or submodule operations. Mentions of coding over SSH or connecting CI runners are network access, not Git functionality.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository
